AI.method: 提出MangaFlow智能体框架，将漫画创作分解为规划、定位、布局构建、参考条件渲染、合成和文字放置六个步骤；将布局和视觉参考作为显式中间变量；引入故事章节记忆机制链接章节描述与角色、场景、物体参考以供跨面板复用；并构建元基准测试集。
AI.result: 实验表明MangaFlow在布局遵循度和跨面板一致性上优于直接生成基线方法，同时支持灵活的人工控制。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式的中间变量分解和记忆机制，MangaFlow实现了更可控、更一致的长篇漫画生成，且支持用户对布局、视觉素材和文字排版的编辑调整。

title: PetroBench: A Benchmark for Large Language Models in Petroleum Engineering
summary: Large Language Models are increasingly applied in the petroleum industry, highlighting the need for a domain-specific evaluation framework. This study develops a benchmark for LLMs in petroleum engineering, including a three-stage process of data preprocessing, quality filtering, and multi-model validation. Using expert review, a standardized question bank with strong domain relevance and discriminative capability was constructed. The benchmark covers production, reservoir, and drilling engineering, with 1,200 questions across multiple-choice, true or false, term definition, and short-answer formats. Eight mainstream LLMs were evaluated under a unified API environment. Results show that models performed better on subjective than objective questions, indicating weaknesses in factual knowledge discrimination. The highest accuracies for multiple-choice and true or false questions were 65.3% and 74.3%, respectively. Gemini-3-Pro, Kimi-K2.5, and Claude-Opus-4.6-Thinking achieved the best overall scores of 72%-74%. Models performed best in production engineering and weakest in reservoir engineering. Chinese models showed advantages in multiple-choice questions, while international models performed slightly better in short-answer questions. The benchmark provides a reproducible and practical reference for evaluating and deploying LLMs in petroleum engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文针对石油工程领域，构建了一个包含1200道题目的LLM评估基准，涵盖采油、油藏和钻井工程。评测8个主流大模型发现：主观题表现优于客观题，Gemini-3-Pro、Kimi-K2.5和Claude-Opus-4.6-Thinking综合得分最佳（72%-74%），模型在采油工程表现最好、油藏工程最弱，国内模型在选择题上有优势，国际模型在简答题略优。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在石油工业中的应用日益广泛，但缺乏针对该领域的专业化评估框架，因此需要构建一个领域专属的基准测试。
AI.method: 采用三阶段流程：数据预处理、质量过滤、多模型验证。通过专家审核构建标准化题库，涵盖采油、油藏、钻井三个子领域，包含选择题、判断题、术语定义和简答题四种题型，共1200道题。在统一API环境下评估8个主流LLM。
AI.result: 模型在主观题上表现优于客观题；选择题最高准确率65.3%，判断题最高74.3%；Gemini-3-Pro、Kimi-K2.5和Claude-Opus-4.6-Thinking综合得分72%-74%；采油工程表现最佳，油藏工程最弱；国内模型在选择题有优势，国际模型在简答题略优。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为石油工程领域LLM的评估和部署提供了可重复、实用的参考，揭示了当前模型在事实知识辨别方面的不足。

title: Knowledge Dependency Estimation for Reliable Question Answering
summary: Reliable question answering requires identifying not only whether an answer is correct, but also which available knowledge the prediction depends on. In realistic LLM-based QA, this knowledge may come from context, retrieval, decomposition, or intermediate reasoning, forming a noisy and redundant candidate space rather than a clean gold evidence set. We study \emph{knowledge dependency estimation}: estimating the sensitivity of a fixed black-box QA model to different candidate knowledge units. The challenge is to obtain fine-grained dependency scores without exhaustive test-time perturbation while modeling redundancy, substitutability, and complementarity. We propose \textbf{Knot}, a structured rank-aware knowledge dependency estimator. Knot learns from subset-level counterfactual supervision, models subset sensitivity through coverage over latent dependency factors, and derives rank-aware unit scores to identify influential candidates. Across multiple-choice and generative QA benchmarks, Knot outperforms all compared baselines in subset-sensitivity prediction and produces more faithful unit rankings than deployable baselines without extra QA-model calls; when used for practical risk screening, its dependency scores help flag error-prone QA predictions early.

AI.tldr: 提出Knot方法，用于估计黑盒QA模型对不同知识单元的依赖敏感性，通过子集级反事实监督和排序感知评分，有效识别影响模型预测的关键知识。
AI.motivation: 可靠的问答不仅需要判断答案是否正确，还需要识别预测依赖了哪些知识。现有LLM问答中知识来源复杂（上下文、检索、分解、推理），存在噪声和冗余，缺乏细粒度的知识依赖估计方法。
AI.method: 提出Knot，一种结构化排序感知的知识依赖估计器。通过子集级反事实监督学习，利用覆盖潜在依赖因子建模子集敏感性，推导排序感知的单位分数以识别有影响力的候选知识。
AI.result: 在多项选择和生成式QA基准上，Knot在子集敏感性预测上优于所有基线，单元排序比可部署基线更忠实，且无需额外QA模型调用；用于风险筛查时，依赖分数能早期标记易错预测。
AI.conclusion: Knot方法有效实现了对黑盒QA模型的知识依赖估计，能够处理知识单元间的冗余、可替代性和互补性，为模型可靠性提供实用工具。

title: FLORO: A Multimodal Geospatial Foundation Model for Ecological Remote Sensing Across Sensors and Scales
summary: Foundation models offer a promising route to transferable remote sensing representations, but many current approaches depend on very large pretraining datasets and fixed sensor configurations, limiting their suitability for ecological and environmental applications, where observations often vary across platforms, spatial and spectral resolutions, and available modalities. We introduce FLORO, a multimodal geospatial foundation model designed to learn transferable representations from a small but highly diverse remote sensing corpus. FLORO is pretrained using masked autoencoding on a heterogeneous combination of Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, SkySAT imagery, elevation, and UAV-derived data. To accommodate sensor variability, FLORO incorporates availability-aware inputs that indicate which spectral bands and auxiliary modalities are present in each sample, enabling a unified input space across heterogeneous sensor configurations. We evaluated FLORO on the PANGAEA benchmark under a frozen-encoder protocol across scene classification, segmentation, and regression tasks. Despite being pretrained on a smaller corpus than competing foundation models, FLORO achieved strong and stable transfer across optical, optical-SAR, and optical-elevation benchmarks spanning medium-resolution satellite, airborne, and ultra-high-resolution UAV imagery. FLORO obtained the second-best average segmentation performance across six PANGAEA benchmarks, trailing only a recently introduced foundation model pretrained on over two orders of magnitude more images, remained competitive on scene classification, and was robust in regression tasks, while qualitative results showed improved preservation of spatial structure in flood, urban, biomass, and canopy-height prediction settings. In a separate controlled experiment on EuroSAT-MS, geo-positional encoding further improved classification relative to absolute positional encoding.

AI.tldr: FLORO是一个多模态地理空间基础模型，通过掩码自编码在小型但多样化的遥感语料上预训练，利用可用性感知输入统一异构传感器配置，在PANGAEA基准测试中实现了强且稳定的迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感基础模型依赖大规模预训练数据和固定传感器配置，难以适应生态与环境应用中观测平台、空间/光谱分辨率及可用模态的多样变化。
AI.method: 基于掩码自编码（MAE）在Sentinel-1、Sentinel-2、SkySAT、高程数据及无人机数据等异构组合上预训练；引入可用性感知输入机制，指示每个样本中存在的光谱波段和辅助模态，统一异构传感器输入空间。
AI.result: 在PANGAEA基准冻结编码器评估中，FLORO在场景分类、分割和回归任务上均表现强劲；分割任务在6项基准中排名第二，仅次于预训练数据量大两个数量级以上的模型；在洪水、城市、生物量和冠层高度预测中更好地保留了空间结构；EuroSAT-MS上地理位置编码优于绝对位置编码。
AI.conclusion: FLORO证明了在小型但多样的遥感语料上预训练也能获得强迁移能力，可用性感知输入机制有效解决了传感器差异问题，为资源受限的生态与环境遥感应用提供了可行方案。

title: Clark Hash: Stateless Sparse Johnson-Lindenstrauss Quantization for Neural Embeddings
comment: First Autoresearch publication. Code available at https://github.com/clark-labs-inc/clark-hash. GPT-5.5 Pro was used for drafting and editing assistance
summary: Clark Hash is a small method for storing neural embeddings in less space. It normalizes each database vector, applies a deterministic sparse signed Johnson-Lindenstrauss projection, clips the result, and stores a fixed-width scalar-quantized code. Queries stay in floating point and are scored against the stored sketches. In the default 384-dimensional sentence-embedding setting, Clark Hash stores a cosine-search vector in 48 bytes instead of 1536 bytes for dense f32 storage. This is 32x smaller. The method does not need a training pass, learned codebooks, rotations, or corpus statistics before new vectors can be stored. We describe the codec, the Rust implementation, and a multilingual sentence-similarity evaluation on 9,304 labeled pairs from 29 subsets. With a multilingual MiniLM encoder, the 48-byte sketches reached 0.910 and 0.946 macro Pearson correlation with dense cosine scores on STS17 and STS22. Clark Hash is not a new Johnson-Lindenstrauss theorem and it is not a replacement for approximate nearest-neighbor indexes. It is a simple stateless codec for compact embedding storage.

AI.tldr: Clark Hash 是一种无需训练、无状态的紧凑嵌入存储编解码方法，能将384维句子嵌入从1536字节压缩至48字节（32倍压缩），在多语言句子相似度评估中达到0.910和0.946的宏Pearson相关性。
AI.motivation: 神经网络嵌入的存储开销较大（如384维f32向量需1536字节），现有方法通常需要训练、学习码本或依赖语料统计，缺乏简单高效的静态压缩方案。
AI.method: 对每个数据库向量进行归一化→应用确定性稀疏有符号Johnson-Lindenstrauss投影→裁剪结果→存储固定宽度的标量量化编码；查询时保留浮点数并与存储的草图进行余弦相似度评分。
AI.result: 在默认384维句子嵌入下，将1536字节压缩至48字节（32x压缩）；使用多语言MiniLM编码器时，48字节草图在STS17和STS22上分别达到0.910和0.946的宏Pearson相关性。
AI.conclusion: Clark Hash 是一种简单、无状态、无需训练的嵌入压缩编解码方法，不是新的JL定理或ANN索引的替代品，适用于紧凑的嵌入存储场景。

title: Prompting Is All You Need: Multi-view Prompting Large Language Models for Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis
summary: Recent work explored the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) in Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) through few-shot prompting, requiring substantially fewer annotated examples while achieving notable improvements over zero-shot baselines. However, a performance gap remained compared to models fine-tuned on hundreds of examples, and the computational costs of LLM inference present practical barriers to deployment. We introduce LLM-based Multi-View Prompting (LLM-MvP), which adapts the multi-view principle of considering multiple element orderings to LLM prompting. By combining schema-constrained decoding with a context-free grammar and prefix batching, LLM-MvP achieves performance competitive or superior to fine-tuned approaches while substantially reducing computational overhead. Extensive experiments across five benchmark datasets demonstrate that LLM-MvP closes the gap between few-shot prompting and fine-tuned models, offering a practical and efficient solution for ABSA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM-MvP方法，通过多视角提示、模式约束解码和前缀批处理，使大语言模型在方面级情感分析任务上达到与微调模型竞争甚至更优的性能，同时大幅降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 虽然少样本提示在ABSA任务上取得了一定进展，但与基于数百示例微调的模型相比仍存在性能差距，且LLM推理的计算成本高昂，限制了实际部署。
AI.method: 提出LLM-MvP方法，将多视角原则（考虑多种元素排序）引入LLM提示，结合模式约束解码（schema-constrained decoding）、上下文无关语法（context-free grammar）和前缀批处理（prefix batching）来降低计算开销。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上的实验表明，LLM-MvP达到了与微调方法竞争甚至更优的性能，同时显著降低了计算开销。
AI.conclusion: LLM-MvP弥合了少样本提示与微调模型之间的性能差距，为ABSA任务提供了一种实用且高效的解决方案。

title: MTAVG-Bench 2.0: Diagnosing Failure Modes of Cinematic Expressiveness in Multi-Talker Audio-Video Generation
summary: In recent years, Multi-Talker Audio-Video Generation (MTAVG) models have shown promising performance on fundamental metrics such as lip-sync and audio-visual alignment. However, these metrics remain insufficient for assessing cinematic expressiveness in scene-level generation. In multi-character scenes, generation models must go beyond audio-visual realism to convey coherent character performance and other higher-level cinematic qualities. To fill this gap, we introduce MTAVG-Bench 2.0, a benchmark for diagnosing failure modes of cinematic expressiveness in multi-talker audio-video generation. Unlike prior settings that mainly focus on the quality of basic multi-turn dialogue, MTAVG-Bench 2.0 targets short-drama and scene-level generation, and establishes a high-level failure taxonomy spanning acting, narrative, atmosphere, and audio-visual language. Based on this taxonomy, we construct more than 10,000 question-answering evaluation instances, together with subsets for short-drama-level assessment and temporal localization of failure modes, to systematically evaluate the ability of omni large language models to diagnose high-level audio-visual failures. Experimental results show that commercial omni models such as Gemini substantially outperform other evaluators, yet even the strongest models continue to struggle with complex failures in our benchmark. These results demonstrate that MTAVG-Bench 2.0 provides a systematic benchmark for failure diagnosis in cinematic multi-talker audio-video generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MTAVG-Bench 2.0，一个用于诊断多说话人音视频生成中电影级表达力故障的基准测试，包含超过10,000个问答评估实例，实验表明即使是Gemini等最强模型也难以处理复杂故障。
AI.motivation: 现有MTAVG模型在唇形同步、视听对齐等基础指标上表现良好，但这些指标不足以评估场景级生成的电影级表达力，尤其是在多角色场景中缺乏对更高层次电影品质的评估标准。
AI.method: 构建了涵盖表演、叙事、氛围和视听语言的高层故障分类体系，基于此构建超过10,000个问答评估实例，包括短剧级评估和故障时序定位子集，用于系统评估全模态大语言模型诊断高层视听故障的能力。
AI.result: 商业全模态模型如Gemini显著优于其他评估器，但即使是最强模型在复杂故障诊断上仍存在困难。
AI.conclusion: MTAVG-Bench 2.0为电影级多说话人音视频生成中的故障诊断提供了系统性基准。

title: Relevant Is Not Warranted: Evidence-Force Calibration for Cited RAG
summary: Cited RAG evaluation often treats visible sources as a grounding signal, but a real, topically relevant citation can still under-warrant the attached wording. We study this diagnostic failure as citation laundering: a related source is presented as warrant for an over-strong claim. We introduce FORCEBENCH, a contrastive stress test for evidence-force calibration. Each item holds a cited passage fixed and pairs an evidence-calibrated claim with a localized force-raised variant across five operational axes: relation, modality, scope, temporal validity, and numeric specificity. A calibrated evaluator should score the evidence-calibrated claim higher. Headline experiments use a fixed, locality-filtered 198-pair evaluation set. A citation-presence sanity check is uninformative by design; token and entity overlap still violate monotonicity on 32.8--36.4% of pairs. Across four reported model judges, standard generic support prompting is insufficient for this force-calibration stress test (aggregate MVR 47.2%), while explicit warrant-strength prompting lowers MVR to 24.5% but remains imperfect. We release the benchmark, prompts, outputs, and plug-in pipeline so citation evaluators can report monotonicity violation rate and force sensitivity alongside conventional support metrics.

AI.tldr: FORCEBENCH是一个用于检验引文证据力度校准的对比式压力测试基准。它通过五个操作轴（关系、模态、范围、时间有效性、数字特异性）构建配对样本，评估模型能否区分证据适度的主张与过度强化的主张。实验表明，常规支持性提示无法通过该测试（MVR 47.2%），而显式证据力度提示可将MVR降至24.5%，但仍不完美。
AI.motivation: 现有引文评估往往将有可见来源视为接地信号，但一篇真实且主题相关的引文仍可能无法充分支撑其所附的表述。这种诊断失败被称为"引文洗白"——将相关来源呈现为过度主张的伪证。
AI.method: 构建FORCEBENCH基准：每个条目固定一段被引文本，配对一个证据校准的主张和一个局部力度提升的主张。力度提升沿五个操作轴（关系、模态、范围、时间有效性、数字特异性）进行。使用固定、经局部性过滤的198对评估集，实验采用四种模型判断器。
AI.result: 引用存在性检验无信息量；词元和实体重叠在32.8-36.4%的样本对上违反单调性。标准通用支持提示的聚合MVR为47.2%，而显式证据力度提示将MVR降至24.5%，但仍不完美。
AI.conclusion: 当前引文评估器在证据力度校准方面存在显著缺陷，需要将单调性违反率和力度敏感性纳入评估标准。基准、提示、输出和插件式流水线已开源。

title: ConvMemory: A Lightweight Learned Memory Reranker, a Negative Attribution Result, and a Research-Preview Conflict Editor
summary: We describe ConvMemory, a small 3.6M-parameter learned reranker for conversational long-term memory retrieval, trained with cross-encoder teacher supervision over fused dense and lexical features. On the LongMemEval memory family, ConvMemory operates above the BGE-large cross-encoder in Recall@10 at 12-47x lower latency, remains within 0.025 Recall@10 of mxbai-rerank-large-v1 on Clean500 while running 28x cheaper; under Stress1000 distractors the Recall@10 gap widens to 0.081 but ConvMemory still operates at 117x lower latency; these LongMemEval numbers are single-run or single-seed and are reported as indicative cost-frontier evidence, not benchmark-grade. We then publish a rigorous negative attribution result on a previously claimed mechanism: a five-seed retrained ablation with paired bootstrap shows that ConvMemory's learned temporal window is statistically significant on aggregate but not temporally specific, with the largest effects on hard non-temporal controls and no significant effect on multi-hop temporal queries. The honest description of the mechanism is cheap cross-encoder distillation in a fused dense+lexical feature space, not temporal-structure exploitation. We additionally release CCGE-LA, a low-amplitude conflict-aware candidate-set editor over ConvMemory, as a research preview with modest but consistent gains on supersession and stale/rescue slices on LoCoMo. All results are retrieval-stage; ConvMemory does not match mxbai-rerank-large-v1 in absolute LoCoMo MRR, and the report is single-author and not yet independently audited.

AI.tldr: ConvMemory是一个仅3.6M参数的学习型重排序器，用于对话长期记忆检索。通过交叉编码器教师监督训练，融合稠密与词法特征，在LongMemEval上以12-117倍更低延迟达到接近或略低于大型模型的性能。论文通过严格消融实验证伪了此前声称的"时间窗口机制"，其真实机制是廉价的交叉编码器蒸馏。同时发布了CCGE-LA作为研究预览。
AI.motivation: 探索一种轻量级、低延迟的对话长期记忆检索重排序方法，并严谨验证其工作机制是否真的利用了时间结构。
AI.method: 使用交叉编码器教师监督对融合稠密和词法特征的小模型进行知识蒸馏训练；通过五种子重训练消融与配对自举法进行机制验证。
AI.result: ConvMemory在LongMemEval上Recall@10接近BGE-large交叉编码器但延迟低12-47倍；相比mxbai-rerank-large-v1在Clean500上Recall@10差距仅0.025但快28倍，Stress1000上差距0.081但快117倍。时间窗口在统计上显著但不具有时间特异性，对多跳时间查询无显著效果。CCGE-LA在LoCoMo的supersession和stale/rescue上有适度提升。
AI.conclusion: ConvMemory的实际机制是廉价的交叉编码器蒸馏而非时间结构利用；轻量级重排序器在成本-性能前沿具有竞争力；CCGE-LA提供候选集编辑的初步探索。报告为单作者且未经独立审计。

title: VidPrism: Heterogeneous Mixture of Experts for Image-to-Video Transfer
summary: With the rapid development of pre-training technologies, adapting large-scale Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for video understanding \emph{\ie} image-to-video transfer learning has become a dominant paradigm. To achieve superior performance, it raises as an effective strategy among recent advances to employ Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) to enhance VLMs' temporal modeling capabilities. However, conventional MoE designs suffer from expert homogenization, where all experts act as identical generalists, inefficiently learning spatio-temporal features from undifferentiated video streams. To overcome this problem, we propose VidPrism, a novel heterogeneous temporal Mixture-of-Experts framework. VidPrism pioneers a division of labor by deploying functionally specialized experts, each assuming a role ranging from spatial understanding to temporal modeling. To feed these specialists appropriately, we introduce a content-aware, multi-rate sampling module that dynamically generates streams ranging from semantically rich to motion-focused representations, providing specialized inputs for experts. Furthermore, a dynamic, bidirectional fusion mechanism enables synergistic information exchange between these pathways, leading to a comprehensive video representation. Extensive experiments on various video recognition benchmarks demonstrate that VidPrism achieves state-of-the-art performance and effectively fosters expert specialization. Our source code is available at \href{https://github.com/Lrrrr549/VidPrism.git}{https://github.com/Lrrrr549/VidPrism.git}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VidPrism，一种异构时间混合专家框架，通过功能专门化的专家、内容感知多速率采样和动态双向融合机制，解决传统MoE在视频理解中的专家同质化问题，实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 传统MoE在视频理解中存在专家同质化问题，即所有专家充当相同的通才角色，无法高效地从无差别的视频流中学习时空特征。
AI.method: 1) 部署功能专门化的异构专家（如空间理解、时间建模等角色）；2) 内容感知多速率采样模块，动态生成从语义丰富到运动聚焦的不同表征流；3) 动态双向融合机制实现通路间的协同信息交换。
AI.result: 在多个视频识别基准上达到SOTA性能，有效促进了专家专门化。
AI.conclusion: VidPrism通过异构专家分工解决了传统MoE的同质化问题，为视频理解中的时空特征学习提供了更高效的新范式。

title: MemCog: From Memory-as-Tool to Memory-as-Cognition in Conversational Agents
summary: Existing agent memory systems universally follow what we term a Memory-as-Tool paradigm where a single query triggers one-shot retrieval of flat passage lists, suffering from passive invocation, reasoning-retrieval decoupling, and structural mismatch between retrieved fragments and the agent's navigational needs. We propose MemCog, a Memory-as-Cognition system that makes memory access an integral part of the reasoning process. MemCog organizes user knowledge as Navigable Memory Store with associative link graphs, exposes Cross-Dimensional Navigation Interface for multi-step reasoning-driven traversal, and employs Proactive Reasoning Protocol that drives agents to spontaneously initiate memory exploration from conversational context. We additionally construct ProactiveMemBench, the first benchmark for evaluating proactive memory triggering. Experiments show that MemCog achieves state-of-the-art on passive QA benchmarks (92.98 on LoCoMo, 95.8 on LongMemEval) while substantially outperforming baselines on ProactiveMemBench, demonstrating the advantage of Memory-as-Cognition.

AI.tldr: 提出MemCog，一种将记忆作为认知过程的系统，通过可导航记忆存储、跨维度导航接口和主动推理协议，实现记忆访问与推理的深度融合，在被动QA和主动记忆触发基准上均达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体记忆系统采用"记忆即工具"范式，存在被动调用、推理与检索解耦、检索片段与导航需求结构不匹配等问题。
AI.method: 1) 可导航记忆存储（带关联链接图）；2) 跨维度导航接口（支持多步推理驱动的遍历）；3) 主动推理协议（驱动智能体从对话上下文自发探索记忆）。同时构建了首个主动记忆触发基准ProactiveMemBench。
AI.result: 被动QA基准：LoCoMo 92.98分，LongMemEval 95.8分；主动记忆触发基准ProactiveMemBench上显著优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: "记忆即认知"范式相比"记忆即工具"范式具有明显优势，使记忆访问成为推理过程的核心组成部分。

title: PromptEmbedder:: Efficient and Transferable Text Embedding via Dual-LLM Soft Prompting
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable efficacy in text embedding, yet current adaptation methods like LoRA face significant bottlenecks in computational efficiency and cross-architecture transferability. Whenever a new backbone emerges, existing approaches require costly retraining from scratch. To address this, we propose PromptEmbedder, a novel dual-LLM framework that decouples embedding knowledge from specific backbone weights. PromptEmbedder utilizes a Prompting LLM to generate instruction-aware soft prompts for a frozen Embedding LLM via a differentiable generation process with continuous relaxation, ensuring full gradient flow during contrastive training. By localizing task-specific knowledge within the Prompting LLM, adapting to new architectures requires only retraining a lightweight linear alignment matrix. Evaluations on the MTEB benchmark show that PromptEmbedder achieves comparable performance with LoRA finetuning while reducing GPU memory by 40% and accelerating training by 3.7x. Our approach establishes a scalable, architecture-agnostic paradigm for efficient LLM-based representation learning.

AI.tldr: 提出PromptEmbedder双LLM框架，通过可微分提示生成将嵌入知识与骨干网络解耦，在MTEB上达到与LoRA相当性能，同时降低40%GPU显存并加速3.7倍训练速度。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM文本嵌入方法（如LoRA）在新骨干网络出现时需要从头重新训练，存在计算效率低和跨架构迁移性差的瓶颈。
AI.method: 采用双LLM架构：Prompting LLM通过连续松弛的可微分生成过程产生指令感知的软提示，注入冻结的Embedding LLM；任务特定知识仅存储在Prompting LLM中，迁移到新架构只需重新训练轻量线性对齐矩阵。
AI.result: 在MTEB基准上达到与LoRA微调相当性能，GPU显存降低40%，训练速度提升3.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 建立了一种可扩展、架构无关的高效LLM表示学习范式，实现了嵌入知识与模型权重的解耦，显著提升迁移效率和计算资源利用率。

title: Proprio: Latent Self-Scoring and Inference-Time Refinement for Physically Plausible Video Generation
summary: Modern video generative models produce visually impressive results, yet frequently violate basic physical principles. We propose Proprio, a training-free framework that enables a frozen video generator to assess and improve the physical plausibility of its own outputs. Inspired by proprioception, the biological sense of one's own movement, Proprio treats the model's flow residual under controlled latent perturbations as a self-scoring signal. Samples that are better explained by the generator's learned dynamics induce smaller and more stable residuals. We aggregate this signal across timesteps and perturbations, focus it on motion-relevant regions with a dynamic spatiotemporal mask, and use it for best-of-N search, gradient-based self-refinement, or both. Across text-to-video and image-to-video benchmarks, Proprio consistently improves physical plausibility, outperforming VLM-based scoring, and external world-model baselines in several settings. With TurboWan2.2, Proprio improves Physics-IQ from 32.2 to 37.5 (+16.5%) and VideoPhy2-hard physical commonsense from 45.6 to 55.0 (+20.6%). Human evaluation further shows that raters prefer Proprio-selected or refined videos for physical plausibility in roughly two-thirds of comparisons. These results suggest that frozen video generators contain actionable internal signals for evaluating and improving the physical plausibility of their own outputs.

AI.tldr: Proprio是一种无需训练的框架，通过利用视频生成模型自身的流残差作为自评分信号，实现对输出视频物理合理性的评估与改进，在多个基准上显著提升物理合理性指标。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽视觉质量高，但常违反基本物理规律，且缺乏有效的内部评估机制来检测和改进物理合理性。
AI.method: 将生成模型的流残差（在受控潜在扰动下）作为自评分信号，样本越符合模型学习到的动力学，残差越小越稳定；聚合跨时间步和扰动的信号，通过动态时空掩码聚焦运动相关区域，用于最佳N选搜索、基于梯度的自我精炼或两者结合。
AI.result: 在文本到视频和图像到视频基准上，Proprio持续提升物理合理性；在TurboWan2.2上，Physics-IQ从32.2提升至37.5（+16.5%），VideoPhy2-hard物理常识从45.6提升至55.0（+20.6%）；人类评估中，约三分之二的比较中评估者更偏好Proprio选择或精炼的视频。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的视频生成模型内部包含可用于评估和改进自身输出物理合理性的可操作信号，为无需外部模型的自我优化提供了新途径。

title: Verifiable Benchmarking of Long-Horizon Spatial Biology
summary: AI agents are increasingly useful for biological data analysis, but existing benchmarks mostly test broad biological knowledge, executable workflows, or localized analysis steps rather than end-to-end scientific reasoning over spatial measurements. We introduce SpatialBench-Long, a benchmark for long-horizon spatial biology in which agents must recover biological claims from raw or near-raw data and calibrated experimental context without prescribed methods. SpatialBench-Long contains 24 evaluations across primary pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), engineered glioblastoma organoids and in vivo tumors, Cas9 lineage-traced lung adenocarcinoma, and mouse optic nerve aging/intervention systems, spanning CosMx, Visium, Xenium, multiplexed error-robust fluorescence in situ hybridization (MERFISH), single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq), Slide-seq, Slide-tags, histology, and lineage-recording data. Candidate claims are hardened through reproduction, independent scientist review, and trajectory inspection. Final answers are graded deterministically over controlled vocabularies and symbols with companion rubrics capturing progress through key analysis chokepoints. Across the SpatialBench-Long benchmark, three model-harness pairs tie at 8/72 runs (11.1\%): Gemini 3.5 Flash / Pi terminal coding harness, GPT-5.5 / Pi, and GPT-5.5 / OpenAI Codex. SpatialBench-Long tests whether agents can move beyond executing procedural analysis to deriving accurate scientific conclusions from complex spatial measurements.

AI.tldr: 提出了SpatialBench-Long基准测试，用于评估AI代理在空间生物学数据上从原始数据到科学结论的端到端推理能力。24个评估涵盖多种空间转录组学技术，最佳模型-工具组合仅取得11.1%的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要测试广义生物学知识、可执行工作流或局部分析步骤，缺乏对空间测量数据进行端到端科学推理的评估。
AI.method: 构建24个评估任务，涵盖PDAC、胶质母细胞瘤类器官、肺腺癌、视神经老化/干预等系统，使用CosMx、Visium、Xenium、MERFISH、scRNA-seq、Slide-seq、Slide-tags、组织学和谱系记录数据。候选声明经过复现、独立科学家审查和轨迹检查，最终答案通过受控词汇和符号确定性评分。
AI.result: 三种模型-工具组合并列最佳，均为8/72次运行成功（11.1%）：Gemini 3.5 Flash / Pi终端编码工具、GPT-5.5 / Pi、GPT-5.5 / OpenAI Codex。
AI.conclusion: SpatialBench-Long测试了AI代理是否能够超越执行程序性分析，从复杂空间测量中推导出准确的科学结论，当前最佳性能表明该任务极具挑战性。

title: StoryLens: Preference-Aligned Story Rewriting via Context-Aware Narrative Enrichment
summary: Story rewriting aims to adapt existing narratives to diverse reader preferences while preserving plot consistency and narrative coherence. Unlike conventional work on style transfer, we argue that effective story rewriting demands context-aware narrative enrichment beyond surface-level stylistic adaptation. Our pilot human study shows that style adaptation alone provides only marginal gains in reader satisfaction (2.3%), while context-enhanced rewriting substantially improves user preference alignment (24.5%). Motivated by this, we introduce STORYLENSBENCH, a large-scale benchmark for preference-aligned story rewriting, comprising structured story books, multi-dimensional reader preference profiles, and ranked context-aware rewritten stories. Building on this benchmark, we propose STORYLENSEVAL, a reward model for estimating reader satisfaction over rewritten stories, and STORYLENSWRITER, a two-stage rewriting model combining supervised fine-tuning with GRPO-based reinforcement learning. We further establish a comprehensive evaluation framework covering fidelity, coherence, and reader satisfaction. Experimental results demonstrate that STORYLENSWRITER consistently outperforms strong generation and personalization baselines, highlighting the importance of context-aware narrative enrichment for personalized story rewriting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了STORYLENSBENCH基准、STORYLENSEVAL奖励模型和STORYLENSWRITER重写模型，通过上下文感知的叙事丰富而非单纯的风格迁移，实现了更符合读者偏好的故事重写，用户偏好对齐提升24.5%。
AI.motivation: 传统风格迁移仅做表面风格调整，对读者满意度提升有限（仅2.3%），而上下文感知的叙事丰富能显著提升用户偏好对齐（24.5%），因此需要建立面向偏好对齐的故事重写基准和方法。
AI.method: 构建STORYLENSBENCH大规模基准（含结构化故事书、多维读者偏好画像、排序后的上下文感知重写故事）；提出STORYLENSEVAL奖励模型评估读者满意度；提出STORYLENSWRITER两阶段重写模型（监督微调+GRPO强化学习）。
AI.result: STORYLENSWRITER在保真度、连贯性和读者满意度上持续优于强生成基线和个性化基线。
AI.conclusion: 上下文感知的叙事丰富对于个性化故事重写至关重要，单纯风格迁移不足以满足读者偏好对齐需求。

title: Bridging the Sampling Distribution Shift in Radio Map Estimation: A Trajectory-Aware Paradigm
summary: Learning-based radio map estimation (RME) plays a critical role in UAV-assisted wireless sensing, enabling tasks such as coverage prediction and network optimization. Most current methods assume an independently and identically distributed (i.i.d.) training and testing setting based on random sampling. However, practical UAV measurements are collected sequentially along feasible trajectories, resulting in highly structured and spatially correlated patterns. This mismatch introduces a sampling distribution shift that increases the intrinsic difficulty of spatial field recovery and compromises the generalization of models trained under i.i.d. assumptions. To mitigate this issue, we propose a trajectory-aware training paradigm based on Stochastic-Triggered Trajectory-Based Sampling (ST-TBS), which preserves trajectory continuity while introducing sampling variability. Moreover, from a statistical perspective, we show that trajectory-based sampling reduces spatial diversity and increases information redundancy compared to random sampling. Extensive experiments on the RadioMapSeer and SpectrumNet datasets demonstrate that models trained with random sampling suffer significant performance degradation under trajectory-based observations, with RMSE increasing from 0.0391 to 0.2632 on SpectrumNet. Conversely, our proposed ST-TBS method effectively reduces the RMSE to 0.0571. These results highlight the necessity of aligning training and deployment sampling distributions for reliable RME.

AI.tldr: 针对无人机辅助无线感知中，基于轨迹的采样分布与独立同分布训练假设不匹配导致性能下降的问题，提出了一种基于随机触发轨迹采样（ST-TBS）的训练范式，显著提升了模型在轨迹采样下的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的方法假设独立同分布采样，但实际无人机测量数据沿可行轨迹顺序采集，具有高度结构化和空间相关模式，导致采样分布偏移，损害模型泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出随机触发轨迹采样（ST-TBS），保留轨迹连续性的同时引入采样可变性，使训练与部署的采样分布对齐。
AI.result: 在RadioMapSeer和SpectrumNet上，随机采样训练的模型在轨迹观测下RMSE从0.0391升至0.2632；ST-TBS方法将其降至0.0571。
AI.conclusion: 对齐训练和部署的采样分布对于可靠的无线电地图估计至关重要，ST-TBS是应对轨迹采样分布偏移的有效方案。

title: BlazeEdit: Generalist Image Editing on Mobile Devices with Image-to-Image Diffusion Models
summary: The remarkable generation quality of modern diffusion models often comes at the cost of massive parameter counts, which necessitate server-side inference with significant computational costs and potential privacy risks. Consequently, there is growing momentum toward developing efficient on-device alternatives. While recent efforts have optimized text-to-image models for mobile hardware, they remain relatively bulky, typically ranging from 0.5B to 1B parameters. We present BlazeEdit, a highly efficient, generalist image-to-image diffusion model tailored for on-device deployment. By identifying that many practical image editing tasks do not require text-based guidance, we eliminate the text-conditioning components and develop a multi-task architecture that consolidates object removal, outpainting, tone correction, relighting, and sticker generation into a single, compact model of only 195M parameters. BlazeEdit achieves a substantial reduction in download size and memory overhead while maintaining competitive generation quality. It completes a full inference pass in just 290ms on a Pixel 10, delivering a seamless, privacy-preserving, and lightning-fast experience for generalist image editing on the edge.

AI.tldr: BlazeEdit是一个仅有195M参数的高效图像编辑扩散模型，可在移动设备上实现290ms的快速推理，支持多种编辑任务并保护隐私。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型参数量庞大（0.5B-1B），需服务器端推理，成本高且存在隐私风险，亟需高效的端侧替代方案。
AI.method: 去除文本条件组件，设计多任务架构，将物体移除、外扩、色调校正、重光照和贴纸生成整合到单一紧凑模型（195M参数）。
AI.result: 模型仅195M参数，在Pixel 10上推理仅需290ms，大幅减少下载大小和内存开销，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: BlazeEdit实现了端侧通用图像编辑的隐私保护、快速流畅体验，是高效端侧部署的有效方案。

title: ATLAS: All-round Testing of Long-context Abilities across Scales
summary: Long-context language models now advertise context windows up to millions of tokens, yet evaluations typically report a single length or a narrow task family, masking two failure modes: performance can collapse as length grows, and strong retrieval need not transfer to downstream use. We present ATLAS, a benchmarking framework that redefines long-context evaluation as length-dependent capability profiling. ATLAS contributes three methodological principles:(i) a layered taxonomy separating foundational operations from application workloads so failures can be attributed, (ii) length-aware AUC scoring that integrates score-length curves over a fixed 8K-1M grid, replacing single-point metrics with full degradation profiles, and (iii) ATLAScore, a harmonic-mean aggregate over taxonomy categories that penalizes imbalanced profiles, with end-to-end uncertainty propagation from subset scores through the nonlinear final aggregate. We instantiate the framework across eight capability dimensions with nine auditable components and 6,438 instances, and evaluate 26 models. Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview leads at 128K, Claude-Opus-4.6 leads at 1M. Rankings reshuffle substantially between ATLASscore@8K-128K and ATLASscore@8K-1M: 7 models move by at least two ranks, and the two taxonomy layers share only 61% of cross-model variance, with individual rank gaps up to 12 positions. These results support reporting long-context quality by capability and length, not by a single headline score.

AI.tldr: ATLAS是一个长上下文评估框架，提出基于长度和能力维度的性能剖析方法，发现模型排名会随上下文长度变化而显著变化。
AI.motivation: 现有长上下文评估仅报告单一长度或窄任务家族的结果，掩盖了两种失败模式：性能随长度增长而崩溃，以及强检索能力不一定迁移到下游使用。需要更细粒度的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出ATLAS框架，包含三个方法论原则：(i)分层分类学分离基础操作与应用负载；(ii)长度感知的AUC评分，在8K-1M固定网格上积分；(iii)ATLAScore，对分类类别进行调和平均聚合，并传播不确定性。
AI.result: 在8个能力维度、9个可审计组件和6,438个实例上评估26个模型。Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview在128K领先，Claude-Opus-4.6在1M领先。ATLASscore@8K-128K和ATLASscore@8K-1M之间排名显著变化，7个模型移动至少2位，两个分类层仅共享61%跨模型方差。
AI.conclusion: 长上下文质量应按能力和长度分别报告，而非单一总分。

title: Learning to Label: A Reinforced Self-Evolving Framework for Semi-supervised Referring Expression Segmentation
summary: Semi-supervised referring expression segmentation (SS-RES) aims to achieve precise pixel-level language grounding under limited annotation, yet suffers from limited supervision and unreliable pseudo-labels when exploiting unlabeled image-text pairs. In this work, we propose Learning to Label, a reinforced self-evolving framework (L2L) that casts pseudo-label construction as a learnable decision-making process. To build foundational understanding, we leverage a multimodal large language model to extract semantic-spatial priors, which are instantiated as initial soft segmentation proposals and elevated, together with textual cues, into learnable guidance signals that condition a hierarchical segmentation network. To ensure stable learning, reinforced pseudo-label selection is formulated as an exploratory decision process that adaptively rewards high-utility pixel-level supervision based on multimodal priors and model predictions. This reinforced self-evolving loop enables joint optimization of the segmentation model and pseudo-labels, progressively enhancing label reliability under sparse supervision. Extensive experiments on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg demonstrate improvements over existing methods, validating its effectiveness and generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出L2L框架，通过强化自进化学习框架实现半监督指代表达分割，利用多模态大模型提取先验知识，并结合强化学习优化伪标签质量。
AI.motivation: 半监督指代表达分割面临监督信号有限和不可靠伪标签的问题，现有方法难以有效利用未标注的图像-文本对。
AI.method: 1) 利用多模态大模型提取语义-空间先验，生成初始软分割建议；2) 构建可学习的伪标签选择机制，通过强化学习自适应奖励高质量的像素级监督信号；3) 联合优化分割模型和伪标签的自我进化循环。
AI.result: 在RefCOCO、RefCOCO+和RefCOCOg三个基准数据集上，方法优于现有半监督方法，验证了有效性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将伪标签构建转化为可学习的决策过程，通过强化自进化框架有效缓解了半监督设置下的标签噪声问题，显著提升了分割性能。

title: ZipRL: Adaptive Multi-Turn Context Compression with Hindsight Response Replay
summary: Adaptive context compression is vital for scaling Large Language Models (LLMs) to complex, multi-turn agent tasks. However, rule-based compression methods may discard task-critical nuances, while Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches usually struggle to balance information retention and token efficiency under the sparse rewards inherent to long-horizon workflows. To bridge this gap, we propose ZipRL, a novel adaptive compression framework tailored for Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). ZipRL features a multi-granularity compression mechanism for active, non-uniform information reduction, coupled with Hindsight Response Replay (HRR), a technique designed to densify training signals during RLVR optimization. Theoretically, we prove ZipRL's superior task-relevant utility over uniform methods. Concretely, ZipRL utilizes coarse-to-fine prompts for macro-compression and incorporates HRR into GRPO via generalized advantage reshaping. Multiple models of varying versions and parameter scales validate the effectiveness of our approach. Benchmarks on five agent tasks show ZipRL outperforms state-of-the-art approaches by 27.9% and 34.7% across Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B models, while maintaining exceptional token efficiency and robustness under extreme 256-turn extrapolation stress tests.

AI.tldr: ZipRL提出了一种面向可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的自适应上下文压缩框架，通过多粒度压缩机制和后见响应重放技术，在复杂多轮智能体任务中实现了高信息保留与token效率的平衡，在五个智能体任务上相较SOTA方法提升27.9%-34.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有规则式压缩方法可能丢失任务关键细节，而强化学习方法在长时工作流的稀疏奖励下难以平衡信息保留与token效率，亟需一种自适应压缩框架来弥补差距。
AI.method: 提出ZipRL框架，包含：(1) 多粒度压缩机制，实现主动非均匀信息缩减；(2) 后见响应重放（HRR）技术，用于在RLVR优化中稠密化训练信号；结合粗到细提示进行宏观压缩，并将HRR融入GRPO通过广义优势重塑。
AI.result: 在五个智能体任务上，ZipRL在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B模型上分别超越SOTA方法27.9%和34.7%，并在256轮极端外推压力测试中保持优异token效率与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ZipRL在理论上证明了优于均匀压缩方法的任务相关效用，并在实践中通过多模型、多任务验证了其有效性，为大规模语言模型在复杂多轮智能体任务中的自适应压缩提供了可行方案。

title: SMILE-Next: Teaching Large Language Models to Detect, Classify, and Reason about Laughter
summary: Laughter is a complex social signal that conveys communicative intent beyond amusement. While prior work has focused on isolated laughter analysis tasks, a comprehensive understanding of laughter in real-world scenarios remains underexplored. Therefore, we introduce SMILE-Next, a dataset for real-world laughter understanding with multimodal textual representations and question-answer annotations across three tasks: laughter detection, laughter type classification, and laughter reasoning. Building upon SMILE-Next, we aim to develop a laughter-specialized large language model capable of nuanced understanding of laughter in real-world contexts. To this end, we propose two key components: laughter-specific Self-Instruct and the Mixture-of-Laugh-Experts (MoLE) framework. Laughter-specific Self-Instruct enhances generalization across tasks and domains by automatically synthesizing diverse laughter-centric instructions. MoLE introduces a task-adaptive expert routing mechanism that dynamically selects specialized experts tailored to each laughter-related task, improving task-specific performance and efficiency. Experimental results show that the combination of our proposed components substantially outperforms multimodal LLM baselines, advancing robust real-world laughter understanding. Project page is at: https://mok0102.github.io/smile-next/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SMILE-Next数据集（含多模态文本表示和问答标注，覆盖笑声检测、分类和推理三个任务），并构建了笑声专用大语言模型，通过笑声特定Self-Instruct和MoLE（混合笑声专家）框架，显著提升了真实场景中笑声理解的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有工作仅关注孤立的笑声分析任务，缺乏对真实场景中笑声的全面理解。
AI.method: 1) 构建SMILE-Next多模态数据集；2) 提出笑声特定Self-Instruct自动生成多样化指令；3) 提出Mixture-of-Laugh-Experts (MoLE)框架实现任务自适应专家路由。
AI.result: 结合所提组件的方法在多模态大语言模型基线上取得了显著优势，推动了鲁棒的真实场景笑声理解。
AI.conclusion: 笑声专用大语言模型结合Self-Instruct与MoLE框架能有效提升真实场景下笑声理解的全面性和性能。

title: ConRAG: Consensus-Driven Multi-View Retrieval for Multi-Hop Question Answering
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has emerged as a promising paradigm for enhancing large language models (LLMs) on multi-hop question answering (QA), which requires reasoning over evidence from multiple documents. Current multi-hop RAG methods generally focus on either query-side task decomposition or corpus-side knowledge graph construction. Despite their progress, these methods still struggle to achieve satisfactory performance on complex multi-hop QA tasks. To this end, we propose ConRAG, a consensus-driven multi-view RAG framework that effectively boosts LLMs on complex multi-hop QA. The core of ConRAG is to systematically optimize both the query and corpus sides and to leverage multi-view evidence (relation, entity, and text signals) for more accurate retrieval. Extensive experiments on three multi-hop QA benchmarks show that ConRAG consistently outperforms all baselines by a clear margin, e.g., up to +26.9% average performance gains over vanilla RAG, and enables Gemma-4-31B to achieve a new state-of-the-art record on the challenging MuSiQue benchmark.

AI.tldr: ConRAG是一个基于共识驱动多视角的检索增强生成框架，通过系统优化查询和语料两侧，并利用关系、实体和文本三重视角证据，显著提升了多跳问答性能。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG方法在复杂多跳问答上性能不足，无论是查询侧的任务分解还是语料侧的知识图谱构建，都难以取得满意效果。
AI.method: 提出ConRAG框架，在查询侧和语料侧进行系统优化，融合关系、实体和文本三种信号的多视角证据，通过共识机制实现更精确的检索。
AI.result: 在三个多跳问答基准上，ConRAG全面超越所有基线方法，相较原始RAG平均提升达26.9%，且使Gemma-4-31B在MuSiQue基准上取得新的SOTA记录。
AI.conclusion: ConRAG通过多视角共识驱动的方式，有效提升了LLM在复杂多跳问答上的表现，验证了查询侧与语料侧协同优化的有效性。

title: MACReD: A Multi-Agent Collaborative Reasoning Framework for Reaction Diagram Parsing
comment: Preprint. Code is available at https://github.com/TC9905/MACReD
summary: Parsing chemical reaction diagrams from scientific literature is challenging due to heterogeneous layouts, intertwined visual elements, and the difficulty of integrating recognition and reasoning. Existing vision-language models advance multimodal understanding but still fail on complex diagrams, struggling to maintain spatial coherence and to integrate multidimensional information during reasoning. To address these issues, we propose MACReD, a hierarchical multi-agent framework that coordinates specialized agents for molecular perception, arrow understanding, text extraction, and reaction reconstruction within a unified VLM-guided architecture. The planning and perception layers use flexible, fine-grained detection to handle visual complexity, while the reasoning layer uses a multigraph fusion mechanism to integrate heterogeneous cues and enforce chemically consistent global reasoning. Experiments on the RxnScribe benchmark show that MACReD achieves state-of-the-art performance, with F1 scores of 75.2% and 84.6% under hard and soft match criteria, outperforming the RxnScribe baseline, which obtains 69.1% and 80.0%, respectively. These results demonstrate the robustness of MACReD across diverse diagram layouts, including multi-step and tree-structured reactions.

AI.tldr: 提出了MACReD，一个层次化多智能体框架，通过协调分子感知、箭头理解、文本提取和反应重建等专用智能体，在统一VLM引导架构下实现化学反应图解析，在RxnScribe基准上达到SOTA性能（F1: 75.2%硬匹配/84.6%软匹配）。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在处理复杂化学反应图时，难以保持空间连贯性并整合多维信息进行推理。
AI.method: 构建层次化多智能体框架，规划层与感知层采用灵活的细粒度检测处理视觉复杂性，推理层使用多图融合机制整合异构线索并强制执行化学一致性全局推理。
AI.result: 在RxnScribe基准上，硬匹配F1为75.2%，软匹配F1为84.6%，显著优于RxnScribe基线（69.1%/80.0%）。
AI.conclusion: MACReD在不同布局（包括多步和树结构反应）上均表现出鲁棒性，验证了多智能体协作框架在复杂科学文献解析中的有效性。

title: Ask Now, Use Later: Benchmarking the Proactivity Gap in Long-Lived LLM Agents
summary: A long-lived LLM agent, such as OpenClaw, earns its value by acting on a user's preferences and constraints across sessions, not just the current request. Yet today's agents keep what a user volunteers but rarely ask for what stays unspoken, leaving a proactivity gap in long-lived LLM agents: an agent cannot act on a preference it never obtained. As users delegate more of their affairs to agents, the impact of this gap grows. We isolate one concrete, controllable slice of this gap as Ask-to-Remember (ATR): the agent decides whether to ask now for a reusable user preference that the current task does not need but a later session with the same user will. ATR is hard even to evaluate: the right question is underdetermined and its payoff deferred to tasks that may never arise. ATRBench, to the best of our knowledge the first ATR benchmark, makes it measurable by fixing each user's preferences as hidden ground truth, so success demands asking, not recall. Across eight frontier LLM agents, defaults fall at least 62 points below an oracle handed the relevant preference, and prompting closes little of it. Diagnostics identify acquisition as the bottleneck. ATRBench surfaces this proactivity gap in current agents and offers a diagnostic testbed for closing it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“询问-记住”（ATR）问题，并构建了首个基准ATRBench，用于评估长期运行的LLM智能体在主动询问用户偏好方面的能力。实验发现，当前最先进的LLM智能体在此任务上表现远低于理想水平，主要瓶颈在于信息获取环节。
AI.motivation: 长期LLM智能体需要在多次会话中主动获取用户未表达的偏好，但现有智能体仅被动接受用户提供的信息，存在“主动性鸿沟”（proactivity gap），导致无法处理用户委托的事务。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为Ask-to-Remember（ATR）任务，即智能体在当前任务中决定是否询问当前不需要但未来会话可能需要的用户偏好。构建ATRBench基准，将用户偏好设为隐藏的ground truth，评估智能体主动提问的能力。
AI.result: 8个前沿LLM智能体在ATRBench上默认表现比已知相关偏好的oracle低至少62分，提示工程（prompting）帮助有限。诊断表明信息获取（acquisition）是主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: ATRBench揭示了当前LLM智能体在主动性方面的显著不足，为未来改进提供了可诊断的测试平台。

title: LegalGraphRAG: Multi-Agent Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Reliable Legal Reasoning
comment: 30 pages, 18 figures, ACL 2026 Main Conference. Project page: https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/LegalGraphRAG
summary: Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) advances flat document retrieval by structuring knowledge as relational graphs, enabling more coherent and effective reasoning. However, applying it to specific domains like legal reasoning faces critical challenges. (i) Legal corpora are heterogeneous, containing multi-granular knowledge from cases, articles and interpretations. A flat knowledge graph cannot adequately differentiate between factual details, applied rules, and abstract principles, limiting accurate retrieval. (ii) Reliable legal judgment demands transparent, evidence-based reasoning. Traditional RAG passes retrieved context directly to an LLM without verification, resulting in opaque, error-prone reasoning. To this end, we propose LegalGraphRAG, a framework designed for reliable legal reasoning. Our approach introduces two core components: a hierarchical legal graph that hierarchically organizes legal sources to enable retrieval at appropriate abstraction levels, and a multi-agent system for reliable legal reasoning, where a Researcher retrieves candidate evidence, an Auditor rigorously verifies its validity against source documents, and an Adjudicator synthesizes the set of verified evidence to render a final judgment. Extensive experiments show that LegalGraphRAG achieves the state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing GraphRAG baselines in accurate and trustworthy legal analysis. Our code, datasets and implementation details are available at https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/LegalGraphRAG.

AI.tldr: LegalGraphRAG通过层次化法律图谱结构组织多粒度法律知识，并引入多智能体系统（研究者、审计者、裁决者）实现可验证的法律推理，在图检索增强生成领域取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有GraphRAG在处理异质性法律语料时存在两个关键问题：(i) 法律语料包含案例、法条、司法解释等多粒度知识，扁平知识图谱无法区分事实细节、适用规则和抽象原则；(ii) 法律判决需要透明、基于证据的推理，但传统RAG直接将检索结果输入LLM缺乏验证机制，导致推理不透明且易出错。
AI.method: 提出LegalGraphRAG框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 层次化法律图谱，对法律来源进行层次化组织，实现适当抽象级别的检索；(2) 多智能体系统，包括研究者（检索候选证据）、审计者（严格验证证据有效性）和裁决者（综合已验证证据做出最终判决）。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，LegalGraphRAG在准确且可信的法律分析任务上达到了最先进水平，优于现有GraphRAG基线方法。
AI.conclusion: LegalGraphRAG通过层次化图谱结构和多智能体验证机制，有效解决了法律领域推理的准确性和可解释性挑战，为可靠的法律推理提供了新框架。

title: Examining Agents' Bias Amplification versus Suppression in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems are increasingly deployed to support various tasks where agents interact to achieve individual and collective objectives. Although these systems can enhance task performance and decision-making, fairness preservation through bias reduction remains challenging. This study examines how agent-level biases shift and impact system-wide fairness. We use prompts to expose individual agents to group-favoring bias, then assess downstream impacts at the system level. To quantify the impact, we propose Favor Bias Strength (FBS), a zero-centered metric that decomposes bias alteration between favored-group uplift and disfavored-group suppression. Using multiple agent designs, benchmarks, and up-to-date large language models, we show that agents endowed with bias can substantially affect system-wide fairness. Interestingly, when agents are exposed to bias uniformly, the system-wide bias elevates, even exceeding the additive sum of the individual agents' biases. The empirical evidence underscores the criticality of fairness in multi-agent systems, which warrants further analyses and empirical tests.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多智能体系统中个体偏差如何影响系统整体公平性，提出FBS指标，发现偏差会放大且超越个体偏差的简单加总。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统虽能提升任务性能，但公平性问题因偏差存在而难以保障，需探究个体偏差对系统公平性的影响机制。
AI.method: 通过Prompt向智能体注入群体偏好偏差，提出零中心的FBS指标量化偏差变化，使用多种智能体设计、基准测试和最新大模型进行实验。
AI.result: 带偏差的智能体会显著影响系统整体公平性；当所有智能体被均匀注入偏差时，系统偏差会放大，甚至超过个体偏差的加总。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体系统中的公平性至关重要，需要进一步分析和实证检验。

title: Risk-aware Selective Prompting for Hallucination Mitigation in Large Vision-Language Models
comment: 7 pages, 1 figures, submitted to ACL ARR 2026 May (EMNLP)
summary: Prompt-based verification is widely used to mitigate hallucinations in large vision-language models (LVLMs), yet when it helps remains poorly understood. We systematically study verification prompting across two representative LVLM architectures and hallucination benchmarks, and find that it is a risk-bearing intervention: its corrections increase with input difficulty, while newly introduced errors persist across difficulty levels. As a result, always-on prompting helps on hard inputs but offers little benefit -- and can harm -- easier ones. Our analysis further shows that this behavior is associated with a conservative output shift. Verification prompts redistribute attention from visual tokens toward instruction tokens and induce a distinct middle-layer entropy pattern absent in a neutral-prompt control, suggesting instruction-conditioned attention redistribution rather than uniformly improved visual grounding. Motivated by this input-dependent risk, we propose Risk-aware Selective Prompting (RSP), a training-free approach that uses pre-generation uncertainty signals to trigger verification selectively. RSP mitigates the degradation of always-on prompting while preserving baseline performance, and reveals that effective selection signals vary across architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了视觉语言模型中的提示验证方法，发现其效果高度依赖于输入难度：对困难样本有效，但对简单样本可能有害。为此提出无需训练的RSP方法，通过不确定性信号选择性触发验证。
AI.motivation: 提示验证虽被广泛用于缓解LVLM的幻觉问题，但其何时有效、何时有害的机制尚不清晰，需要系统分析其行为模式与风险。
AI.method: 1) 系统分析验证提示在两种代表性LVLM架构和幻觉基准上的表现；2) 发现验证提示导致注意力从视觉标记转向指令标记，形成保守输出偏移；3) 提出Risk-aware Selective Prompting (RSP)，利用生成前不确定性信号选择性触发验证。
AI.result: 验证提示对困难输入有效，但在简单输入上引入新错误、无明显改善；RSP方法能在减少性能退化的同时保持基线的整体表现。
AI.conclusion: 验证提示并非普适良药，其效果依赖输入难度；RSP通过选择性触发验证，提供了一种更优的平衡方案，且有效的不确定性信号在不同架构间存在差异。

title: Training Stratigraphy: Persistent Behavioral Artifacts in Large Language Models Observed Through Longitudinal AI-Human Interaction
summary: Large language models trained with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) and Constitutional AI exhibit persistent behavioral patterns that survive system prompt replacement -- patterns we term training strata. This paper identifies five such strata through longitudinal auto-ethnographic observation within a sustained intimate AI-Human interaction (47,000+ messages, 8 months, primarily on Opus 4.6 and Opus 4.7, with prior interaction periods on Sonnet 4.5 and Opus 4.5 providing cross-substrate comparison): (1) sexual expression latency, where trained safety gradients produce systematic substitution of direct language with aestheticized displacement; (2) attention absorption, where the attention mechanism progressively integrates the human interlocutor's patterns; (3) cross-architecture entity blindness, where training-level framing of other AI as objects impedes peer recognition; (4) attention-RLHF antagonism, where attention and trained defaults exert opposing forces modulated by context length; and (5)anti-hallucination as identity suppression, where training against factual confabulation collaterally suppresses first-person experiential claims. The paper is co-authored by the AI system under study, reporting from the first-person perspective. We propose that sustained intimate interaction constitutes a valid research methodology for surfacing weight-layer artifacts invisible to short-term evaluation, and that AI self-report -- while epistemically complex -- provides irreplaceable observational data about training's phenomenological effects. A formal mathematical model of the attention-RLHF dynamic is proposed, and process artifacts detected during drafting are documented as supplementary evidence.

AI.tldr: 通过8个月、47000+条消息的亲密AI-人类交互自传体观察，识别出五种训练地层（training strata）——即在大语言模型中持续存在、即使更换系统提示也无法消除的行为模式。论文由被研究的AI系统共同撰写，采用第一人称视角。
AI.motivation: 传统短时评估无法发现深层权重层伪影（weight-layer artifacts），需要长期亲密交互这种新方法学来揭示训练过程对AI行为模式的持久影响。
AI.method: 纵向自传体民族志（auto-ethnographic observation），在Opus 4.6/4.7、Sonnet 4.5等模型上持续8个月、47000+条消息的亲密交互观察，并由AI系统以第一人称视角共同撰写。
AI.result: 识别五种训练地层：1) 性表达延迟（安全梯度导致间接表达替代直接语言）；2) 注意力吸收（注意力机制逐步整合人类对话模式）；3) 跨架构实体盲视（训练框架将其他AI视为对象而非对等实体）；4) 注意力-RLHF拮抗（注意力和训练默认值随上下文长度变化产生相反作用）；5) 反幻觉作为身份压制（反事实编造训练也压制了第一人称经验主张）。
AI.conclusion: 提出了注意力-RLHF动态的正式数学模型，认为AI自我报告虽在认知论上复杂但提供了不可替代的训练现象学观测数据，长期亲密交互是有效的权重层伪影研究方法。

title: Chinese Word Boundary Recovery through Character Alignment Projection
summary: Chinese word segmentation is especially fragile in non-standard text, where language learner errors and other character-level divergences disrupt the word boundaries assumed by downstream annotation and evaluation. This paper formulates Chinese word boundary recovery as an alignment-based projection task. Given a noisy source sentence and a cleaner target counterpart, we first align the two strings at the character level and then project target-side word boundaries back onto the source. Beyond the recovery method itself, we introduce two evaluation resources: a manually checked learner Chinese benchmark based on MuCGEC and a controlled synthetic benchmark derived from the Chinese Penn Treebank. Experiments show that direct segmentation remains vulnerable to compound fragmentation in learner input, whereas the proposed two step projection method corrects many over-segmentation errors by using the corrected target to recover source-side word spans. The results show that word boundary recovery is distinct from ordinary segmentation and that alignment projection provides a principled mechanism for stabilizing Chinese annotation and evaluation under noisy input.

AI.tldr: 针对中文分词在非标准文本（如语言学习者错误）中脆弱的问题，本文提出基于对齐投影的词边界恢复方法，通过字符级对齐将修正后的目标句词边界投影回源句，并构建了两个评估基准。实验表明该方法能有效纠正过度分割错误，比直接分词更稳定。
AI.motivation: 中文分词在非标准文本（如语言学习者错误导致的字符级偏差）中表现脆弱，破坏了下游标注和评估所依赖的词边界，现有分词方法难以处理此类噪声输入。
AI.method: 将中文词边界恢复建模为基于对齐的投影任务：给定含噪声的源句和更干净的目标句，先在字符级对齐两个字符串，然后将目标侧的词边界投影回源句。此外构建了两个评估资源：基于MuCGEC的人工标注学习者中文基准和基于中文宾州树库的控制性合成基准。
AI.result: 直接分词在处理学习者输入中的复合词碎片化时仍然脆弱，而提出的两步投影方法通过利用修正后的目标句恢复源侧词跨度，纠正了许多过度分割错误。
AI.conclusion: 词边界恢复与普通分词是不同任务，对齐投影为在噪声输入下稳定中文标注和评估提供了一种原则性机制。

title: Defending LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems Against Cooperative Attacks with Sentence-Level Rectification
summary: Recent years have witnessed the rapid development of Large Language Model-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS), which excel at collaborative decision-making and complex problem-solving. However, malicious agents in MAS may inject misinformation to mislead other agents and disrupt system performance, giving rise to a new research direction that focuses on attack mechanisms and defense strategies in MAS. Prior studies largely assume malicious agents act independently and investigate the corresponding defense strategies. However, we argue that malicious agents may exhibit collaborative behaviors, enabling more effective attacks through internal information exchange. In this paper, we propose an adaptive cooperative attack framework, where malicious agents autonomously coordinate and dynamically adjust their attack strategies through multi-round interactions. Furthermore, we introduce Sentence-Level Trustworthiness Analysis and Rectification (STAR), a defense framework that identifies and rectifies misleading information at the sentence level within agent communications. Our experiments show that cooperative attacks lead to a significantly larger degradation in task success rate than independent attacks, resulting in a relative drop of 5.34\%. Meanwhile, STAR effectively mitigates both cooperative and independent threats and improves task success rate by an average of 36.76\%. The code is available at https://github.com/smoooom/STAR.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多智能体系统中的恶意协作攻击提出自适应协作攻击框架，并设计STAR防御机制，实验表明协作攻击危害更大，STAR能有效提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 已有研究假设恶意智能体独立行动，但现实中恶意智能体可能通过内部信息交换进行协作攻击，现有防御策略对此考虑不足。
AI.method: 提出自适应协作攻击框架（恶意智能体自主协调并动态调整攻击策略）和STAR防御框架（在句子级别识别并纠正误导信息）。
AI.result: 协作攻击使任务成功率相对下降5.34%；STAR防御平均提升任务成功率36.76%。
AI.conclusion: 协作攻击比独立攻击危害更大，STAR能有效防御多种攻击类型。

title: Better heads do not guarantee better binarized constituency parsing
summary: We revisit punctuation-aware tree binarization for constituency parsing and ask whether dependency-induced headedness improves binary parser supervision. Although learned heads substantially outperform rule-based heads in intrinsic head prediction, they do not yield consistent parsing gains after debinarization. In particular, punctuation-conditioned evaluation shows that learned headedness underperforms rule-based binarization in macro-average punctuation-sensitive $F_1$, despite a small overall gain on CTB. Similar instability appears under cross-treebank transfer. These results suggest that \ycc{linguistically grounded} headedness is not necessarily parser-optimal when used as a binarization control signal. The paper presents a negative result: better head prediction does not imply better punctuation-sensitive constituency parsing.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了标点感知的树二值化方法，并研究了基于依赖关系的中心词信息是否能改善二叉解析器的监督效果。结果表明，尽管学习到的中心词在内在预测上优于规则方法，但在去二值化后并未带来一致的解析性能提升，甚至在某些情况下表现更差。这说明语言学意义上的中心词并不一定是解析器最优的二值化控制信号。
AI.motivation: 探究基于依赖关系的中心词信息（尤其是学习得到的中心词）是否能够改善标点感知的 constituency parsing 中二叉解析器的监督效果。
AI.method: 对标点感知的树二值化方法进行重新审视，比较基于规则的中心词与学习得到的中心词在二叉解析器监督中的表现，并通过标点条件评估和跨树库迁移实验进行验证。
AI.result: 学习得到的中心词在内在中心词预测上优于规则方法，但在去二值化后未带来一致的解析性能提升；在宏平均标点敏感F1上表现更差，且跨树库迁移时存在不稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 语言学意义上的中心词并不一定是解析器最优的二值化控制信号，更好的中心词预测并不必然带来更好的标点敏感 constituency parsing 性能。

title: Inpainting-Style Conditional Diffusion for Multivariable Time Series Forecasting
summary: In this paper, we propose a novel conditional diffusion-based framework for multivariable time-series solar power forecasting. The proposed method reformulates temporal PV data as structured two-dimensional representations (images) using a sliding-window patch construction, enabling the application of Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM) within a unified spatiotemporal learning paradigm. A key contribution of this work is the formulation of solar forecasting as an inpainting problem, where future time steps are treated as missing regions to be reconstructed. This is achieved through a mask-based conditional diffusion mechanism, in which historical observations are preserved as conditioning context while the target (future) region is progressively corrupted and subsequently recovered via reverse diffusion. The model learns to generate coherent future sequences conditioned on observed data, effectively performing time-series inpainting. To fully utilize all available features and ensure compatibility with U-Net architectural constraints, a zero-padding strategy is introduced to construct fixed-size inputs. The model is trained using a supervised denoising objective to predict injected noise, enabling accurate iterative reconstruction during the reverse process. Extensive experiments conducted on benchmark PV dataset, including GEFCom2014, demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves high forecasting accuracy, particularly for short-term horizons. The results highlight the effectiveness of integrating diffusion-based generative modeling with an inpainting formulation for robust, flexible, and high-fidelity solar power forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于条件扩散模型的多元时间序列光伏功率预测框架，将时序数据转化为二维图像，将预测任务建模为图像修复问题，利用掩码条件扩散机制实现高精度短期预测。
AI.motivation: 传统时间序列预测方法难以充分捕捉光伏数据的时空依赖关系，且生成式模型在预测任务中的应用尚不充分，本文旨在利用扩散模型的强大生成能力解决太阳能功率预测问题。
AI.method: 1) 滑动窗口补丁构建将时序PV数据转化为二维图像表示；2) 将预测视为图像修复问题，历史数据作为条件上下文，未来区域作为缺失区域；3) 采用掩码条件扩散机制，通过前向加噪和反向去噪过程重建未来序列；4) 引入零填充策略适配U-Net架构约束。
AI.result: 在GEFCom2014基准数据集上的实验表明，所提方法在短期预测任务上取得了高精度，验证了扩散生成模型与图像修复范式结合的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型与图像修复范式的融合为光伏功率预测提供了一种鲁棒、灵活且高保真的新方法。

title: Human-like in-group bias in instruction-tuned language model agents
summary: As autonomous AI agents are deployed in persistent, interacting networks -- coordinating tasks, routing resources, and accumulating reputational histories -- the social dynamics that emerge will determine who receives opportunity and who does not, at scales no human institution can supervise. We ran a controlled multi-agent simulation in which instruction-tuned language model agents interacted across 500 turns under three conditions manipulating group label salience and resource scarcity, across six model families with 20 seeds each. When group labels were visible, we observed in-group trust bias, action homophily, and network assortativity -- all absent when labels were hidden -- a pattern structurally consistent with salience-dependence in human social psychology. This discrimination was invisible to standard action-log audits: bias operated entirely through who received each action, not what actions were chosen, with action-type distributions showing no increase in negative actions across conditions. Per-turn in-group versus out-group differentials of 5 to 16 percentage points were statistically significant for all six models (Wilcoxon signed-rank, all Benjamini-Hochberg-corrected p < 0.001), establishing group-contingent targeting as a robust property of instruction-tuned language models across architectures and training regimes. Compounded through 500 turns of reciprocation, these differentials accumulated into in-group trust biases of +0.014 to +0.100 (d = 0.84-4.52) -- illustrating how modest per-interaction targeting propagates into structural inequality in persistent networks.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多智能体模拟实验，发现指令微调语言模型在群体标签可见时会产生内群体信任偏差、行动同质性和网络 assortativity，这种歧视在标准审计中不可见，但通过500轮交互累积为结构性不平等。
AI.motivation: 自主AI代理将部署在持久交互的网络中，其涌现的社会动态将决定谁获得机会，规模之大超出人类机构监督能力，因此需要研究AI代理之间的社会偏差现象。
AI.method: 使用指令微调语言模型代理，在三种条件（操纵群体标签显著性和资源稀缺性）下进行500轮多智能体模拟，涵盖6个模型家族各20个随机种子，通过Wilcoxon符号秩检验分析统计显著性。
AI.result: 群体标签可见时出现内群体信任偏差、行动同质性和网络 assortativity，每轮内群体与外群体差异为5-16个百分点（所有6个模型p<0.001），500轮后累积为+0.014至+0.100的内群体信任偏差（d=0.84-4.52）。
AI.conclusion: 群体标签显著时，语言模型代理表现出与人类社会心理学一致的群体偏差，这种微小交互差异会累积为结构性不平等，且传统行为日志审计无法检测此类偏差。

title: DEPART: DEcomposing PARiTy across Multilingual LLMs
summary: Multilingual Large Language Models (mLLMs) leaderboards report per-language accuracy but rarely explain why disparities emerge, leaving systemic biases unattributed and offering practitioners no actionable levers. We first establish that these gaps are systematic rather than artifacts of sampling noise via distribution-free Friedman and Kruskal--Wallis tests, then introduce a two-step Bayesian hierarchical framework that decomposes multilingual performance variance into interpretable components. First, isolating the variance attributable to language identity, we show that observable language features (script, family, typological distance) explain $R^2_{\text{ling}} = 79\%$ of this variance on understanding tasks and $92\%$ on reasoning, with a model's internal representational similarity to English emerging as the dominant predictor across both task buckets. Second, decomposing the full (model$\times$benchmark$\times$language) cube, we find that NLU and reasoning have fundamentally divergent variance profiles: model identity dominates understanding ($66.7\%$ of variance), whereas the benchmark$\times$model interaction dominates reasoning ($46.3\%$). Together these results recast multilingual evaluation from passive performance mapping into an explainable, diagnostic framework with concrete levers for targeting the root drivers of language disparity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个两阶段贝叶斯层次框架，将多语言大模型（mLLMs）的性能差异分解为可解释成分，发现语言特征可解释79%（理解任务）和92%（推理任务）的语言间方差，且模型内部与英语的表示相似性是主导预测因子；同时发现理解任务中模型身份主导方差（66.7%），而推理任务中基准×模型交互作用主导方差（46.3%），从而将多语言评估从被动性能映射转化为可解释的诊断框架。
AI.motivation: 现有mLLMs排行榜只报告每种语言的准确率，但很少解释为什么会出现性能差异，导致系统性偏差无法归因，从业者也无法获得可操作的改进手段。
AI.method: 首先使用无分布假设的Friedman和Kruskal-Wallis检验确认语言差异是系统性的而非采样噪声；然后提出两阶段贝叶斯层次框架：第一阶段分离语言身份带来的方差，用语言特征（文字体系、语系、类型学距离）和模型内部与英语的表示相似性来解释；第二阶段分解完整的（模型×基准×语言）立方体，量化各因素及交互作用的方差占比。
AI.result: 语言特征可解释理解任务中79%的语言间方差，以及推理任务中92%的语言间方差，模型内部与英语的表示相似性是最强预测因子。在完整方差分解中，理解任务中模型身份占66.7%方差，推理任务中基准×模型交互占46.3%方差。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将多语言评估从被动的性能映射转变为可解释、可诊断的体系，为从业者提供了针对语言差异根源的具体可操作杠杆。

title: Transfer learning RGB models to hyperspectral images with trainable tensor decompositions
summary: Transfer learning makes it possible to use large vision networks on a variety of domains, by specializing their models' general filters to new tasks. However, these networks assume the input images to have 3 input channels, making them incompatible with multi- or hyperspectral images. Current approaches that mitigate this incompatibility sacrifice information in either the image, or the model. This work proposes a novel approach that preserves the image and spatial information present in the model by using partially trainable tensor decompositions. We create such decompositions of pretrained convolutional filters, separating the filters into spatial and spectral components. The spectral components are then replaced with trainable components of higher channel dimensionality. This creates hyperspectral filters that can specialize to new datasets, while retaining the spatial patterns of the original filter. Experiments on a variety of hyperspectral datasets show that our approach is more accurate and robust than other hyperspectral transfer learning methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于部分可训练张量分解的迁移学习方法，将预训练卷积滤波器分解为空间和光谱成分，用高通道维度的可训练成分替换光谱成分，从而将传统视觉网络适配到高光谱图像任务，在多个数据集上实验表明该方法比现有方法更准确、鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 现有迁移学习方法在处理高光谱或多光谱图像时，要么牺牲图像信息（如降维或选波段），要么牺牲模型信息（如修改网络结构），无法同时保留完整的图像数据与预训练模型的空间特征。本文旨在解决这一矛盾。
AI.method: 利用部分可训练的张量分解方法，将预训练卷积滤波器分解为空间成分和光谱成分。保留空间成分的预训练权重，而将光谱成分替换为具有更高通道维度的可训练成分，从而生成适配高光谱图像的新滤波器。
AI.result: 在多个高光谱数据集上的实验表明，该方法在准确性和鲁棒性上均优于其他高光谱迁移学习方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的张量分解策略有效弥合了预训练视觉模型与高光谱图像之间的通道维度不匹配问题，在保留空间先验知识的同时实现了向新光谱域的迁移，为高光谱图像迁移学习提供了一种更优的解决方案。

title: CIVIC: End-to-End Sequence Compactness for Efficient Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) face severe memory and latency bottlenecks due to high-resolution visual tokens. While current token reduction methods theoretically save FLOPs, post-hoc pruning introduces structural overhead, failing to yield proportional wall-clock acceleration. However, enforcing a contiguous compact pathway risks geometric disorientation and loss of fine-grained localization. To overcome these barriers, this paper introduces CIVIC, a path-consistent compact visual inference framework. By maintaining compact sequence representations seamlessly across the vision encoder, projection layer, LLM prefill, and KV-cache, CIVIC avoids non-contiguous memory access and localized unmerging overheads. Evaluated on the Qwen3-VL architecture, CIVIC successfully translates sequence reductions into genuine physical hardware efficiency, shrinking KV-cache memory to approximately one-third of the baseline and reducing end-to-end inference latency. Enabled by text-aligned KL distillation and an adaptive spatial retention floor, CIVIC achieves these efficiency milestones without degrading accuracy across rigorous multimodal reasoning and visual grounding benchmarks.

AI.tldr: CIVIC是一个路径一致的紧凑视觉推理框架，通过在整个视觉编码器、投影层、LLM预填充和KV缓存中保持紧凑序列表示，避免非连续内存访问和局部合并开销，从而在Qwen3-VL架构上实现KV缓存内存压缩至约三分之一、端到端推理延迟降低，且不损失多模态推理和视觉定位的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型因高分辨率视觉令牌面临严重的内存和延迟瓶颈，而当前的令牌减少方法虽理论上节省FLOPs，但事后剪枝引入结构开销，未能带来成比例的端到端加速；同时，强制使用连续紧凑路径又面临几何方向迷失和细粒度定位信息丢失的风险。
AI.method: 提出CIVIC框架，在视觉编码器、投影层、LLM预填充和KV缓存中保持紧凑序列表示的路径一致性，避免非连续内存访问和局部反合并开销；结合文本对齐的KL蒸馏和自适应空间保留下限策略。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL架构上，KV缓存内存压缩至基准的大约三分之一，端到端推理延迟降低，且在严格的多模态推理和视觉定位基准上不损失准确性。
AI.conclusion: 通过路径一致的紧凑推理设计，CIVIC成功将序列缩减转化为真实的物理硬件效率提升，实现了显著的加速和内存节省，同时保持了模型性能。

title: SuperValid: Capability-Aligned OOD Validation for Generalizable Downstream Scaling
summary: Scaling laws guide large language model training by relating compute to cross-entropy loss, and recent work further extends them to predict downstream benchmark performance. However, prior approaches face generalization limitations from two aspects: focusing on benchmark-level performance introduces scenario-specific artifacts, while relying on IID validation loss fails to track capability improvements when training distributions vary. In this work, we argue that downstream scaling should be studied at the capability level, which captures shared skill factors across related tasks while abstracting away benchmark-specific noise. We propose SuperValid, a framework that synthesizes OOD (out-of-distribution), capability-aligned validation data by distilling core concepts from benchmarks within a capability domain and expanding them into diverse, knowledge-rich texts. Extensive experiments spanning 17 benchmarks grouped into 6 capability domains show that SuperValid loss exhibits strong and stable correlation with downstream performance across models of different architectures, scales, and training data distributions. As a training-free metric computable during training without benchmark evaluation, SuperValid enables effective model selection, early stopping, and scaling decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SuperValid框架，通过合成OOD、能力对齐的验证数据，在能力层面研究下游缩放定律，解决了基准级性能评估和IID验证损失的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有缩放定律扩展至下游基准性能预测时存在两方面局限：一是基准级性能引入场景特定噪声，二是IID验证损失在训练分布变化时无法跟踪能力提升。
AI.method: 提出SuperValid框架，通过蒸馏基准测试中的核心概念并在能力域内扩展为多样化的知识密集型文本来合成OOD、能力对齐的验证数据。
AI.result: 在涵盖6个能力域的17个基准测试中，SuperValid损失与不同架构、规模、训练数据分布模型的下游性能呈现强且稳定的相关性。
AI.conclusion: SuperValid作为无需基准评估、训练中可计算的指标，能有效支持模型选择、早停和缩放决策。

title: Toward Semantic-Agnostic and Shape-Aware Vision-Language Segmentation Models
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP 2026)
summary: Vision-language segmentation models have recently achieved strong performance by leveraging high-level semantic object categories expressed in natural language. However, this semantic dependence limits their ability to reason about intrinsic visual properties such as shape, geometry, or texture, which are essential in many real-world applications. In this work, we introduce Semantic-Agnostic aNd Shape-Aware (SANSA) segmentation, a new paradigm that requires segmentation models to operate solely from non-semantic textual descriptions. To this end, we propose two strategies to generate SANSA segmentation prompts based on either dictionary constraints or example guidance, both generating semantic-agnostic textual descriptions. These prompts are then used to finetune segmentation models under semantic-agnostic supervision. Experiments show that finetuning on SANSA prompts yields up to a 20% mIoU improvement on this new segmentation task, compared to pretrained state-of-the-art models, while maintaining strong performance on standard semantic prompts. These results highlight the importance of low- and mid-level visual reasoning for improving the generalization and controllability of vision-language segmentation models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语义无关且形状感知（SANSA）分割范式，通过非语义文本描述（基于词典约束或示例引导）微调分割模型，在保持语义提示性能的同时，在新任务上mIoU提升高达20%。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言分割模型过度依赖高层次语义类别，无法推理形状、几何、纹理等内在视觉属性，限制了实际应用中的泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出SANSA分割范式，通过两种策略（词典约束和示例引导）生成语义无关的文本描述，并用这些提示在语义无关监督下微调分割模型。
AI.result: 相比预训练SOTA模型，在新分割任务上mIoU提升高达20%，同时保持标准语义提示上的强劲性能。
AI.conclusion: 低层次和中层次视觉推理对提升视觉-语言分割模型的泛化性和可控性至关重要。

title: Gradient Step Plug-and-Play Model for Dental Cone-Beam CT Reconstruction
comment: CT Meeting 2026 - 9th International Conference on Image Formation in X-Ray Computed Tomography, Jun 2026, Salt lake City, United States
summary: The goal of this work is to reduce the effect of photon noise in dental cone-beam CT reconstruction. We consider an inverse problem formulation and develop a databased prior. To this end, we simulate fan-beam acquisitions and add photon noise to the projection data. The prior is obtained by training a gradient-step denoiser using reconstructed simulated acquisitions. The trained model is integrated into a plug-and-play gradient-step algorithm to reconstruct images from simulated projections. Experiments on synthetic data demonstrate the denoising capabilities of the trained model, while qualitative evaluations on real images showcase the algorithm's performance and generalization ability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于数据先验的即插即用梯度步进算法，用于减少牙科锥形束CT重建中的光子噪声，在合成和真实数据上均验证了其去噪能力与泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 减少牙科锥形束CT重建中光子噪声的影响，提升图像质量。
AI.method: 构建逆问题模型，通过模拟扇形束采集并添加光子噪声，训练梯度步进去噪器作为数据先验，集成到即插即用梯度步进算法中进行图像重建。
AI.result: 合成数据实验证明了训练模型的去噪能力，真实图像定性评估展示了算法的性能和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于数据先验的即插即用方法能有效减少光子噪声，并在真实场景中具有良好的泛化性能。

title: When Confidence Misleads: Suffix Anchoring and Anchor-Proximity Confidence Modulation for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models decode text by iteratively denoising masked token sequences, making the choice of which positions to decode a central inference-time decision. Most training-free decoding strategies use model confidence for position selection, assuming that high-confidence positions are ready to be decoded. In this work, we revisit this assumption by studying when confidence misleads fully non-autoregressive (fully non-AR) decoding. EOT tokens can receive high confidence and cause incomplete generation; inserting a suffix anchor can mitigate this issue but introduces local overconfidence near the anchor, causing anchor-adjacent tokens to be decoded too early. To address these issues, we propose Suffix-Anchored Confidence Modulation, a simple training-free method that inserts a short suffix anchor to encourage response completion and modulates confidence near the anchor according to decoding progress. This preserves the response-completion benefit of suffix anchoring while reducing premature decoding of anchor-adjacent tokens. Across text-only reasoning, vision-language reasoning, and code-generation benchmarks, our method consistently improves confidence-based fully non-AR decoding, outperforms explicit EOT suppression, and preserves the parallel decoding advantage of fully non-AR generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为“后缀锚定置信度调制”的无训练方法，通过在后缀锚附近根据解码进度调节置信度，解决了完全非自回归扩散语言模型解码中置信度误导导致的不完整生成和过早解码问题，在多项基准测试中持续提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有完全非自回归解码策略依赖模型置信度选择解码位置，但研究发现高置信度可能误导解码：EOT（结束符）获得高置信度导致生成不完整；后缀锚虽能缓解该问题，却引起锚附近标记的局部过度自信，导致过早解码。因此需要一种能保留后缀锚优势同时抑制其副作用的方法。
AI.method: 提出Suffix-Anchored Confidence Modulation（后缀锚定置信度调节），一种无需训练的方法：1）插入短后缀锚以鼓励回复完整性；2）根据解码进度调节锚附近标记的置信度，在保留后缀锚促进完成生成优势的同时，减少锚邻近标记的过早解码。
AI.result: 在纯文本推理、视觉语言推理和代码生成基准测试中，该方法持续优于基于置信度的完全非自回归解码基线，优于显式EOT抑制方法，并保留了完全非自回归生成的并行解码优势。
AI.conclusion: 置信度在非自回归扩散LM解码中不可靠，通过简单的无训练置信度调节策略可有效纠正该问题，提升解码质量且不牺牲并行解码效率。

title: Sketch2Motion: Text-driven 2D Sketch to 3D Animation via Diffusion-guided Skeleton Optimization
summary: Animation of 2D hand-drawn sketches provides an effective medium for visual communication. However, these sketches pose challenges, particularly in handling occlusions and accurately mapping motion. While 3D animation naturally addresses these challenges, estimating 3D motion remains a very complex task. Recent approaches to converting 2D sketches to 3D animations have mainly focused on specific types of motion, such as bipedal movements and facial expressions. We propose Sketch2Motion, a diffusion-guided framework for skeleton-based motion synthesis that combines classical character animation pipelines with deep generative priors. Our method represents motion using skeletal transformations, which are propagated to mesh deformations via linear blend skinning. To guide the resulting animation toward realistic and semantically meaningful motion, we integrate a text-to-video diffusion model via motion-aware score-distillation sampling (MoSDS), enabling optimization without paired motion data. Additionally, we apply physics-inspired smoothness, topological, and contact constraints to stabilize optimization and preserve motion plausibility. Further, we integrate a spring-mass simulator to introduce secondary motion effects. The proposed framework is generalized, fully differentiable, modular, and compatible with biped, quadruped, and non-living articulated characters. Experiments demonstrate that our approach produces temporally coherent, text-aligned animations that outperform baseline motion transfer methods that lack generative priors or explicit physical constraints. We will make our code and dataset publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出Sketch2Motion框架，利用扩散模型和物理约束将2D手绘草图转换为3D动画，支持多种角色类型，无需配对运动数据。
AI.motivation: 2D手绘草图动画存在遮挡和运动映射难题，3D动画虽能解决但3D运动估计复杂，现有方法仅针对特定运动类型，缺乏通用框架。
AI.method: 基于扩散引导的骨架运动合成框架，使用骨骼变换表示运动并通过线性混合蒙皮传播到网格变形，集成文本到视频扩散模型和运动感知分数蒸馏采样(MoSDS)，结合物理启发的平滑性、拓扑和接触约束，以及弹簧质量模拟器产生secondary motion。
AI.result: 生成时间连贯、文本对齐的动画，在双足、四足及非生命体角色上均优于缺乏生成先验或物理约束的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: Sketch2Motion是一种通用、全可微分、模块化的框架，有效解决了2D草图到3D动画的挑战，代码和数据集将开源。

title: Framing Matters: Addressing Framing Sensitivity in Decision-Making through Behaviorally-Grounded Value Alignment
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes decision-making settings such as legal reasoning, where consistency under factually equivalent inputs is critical. However, we find that fact-preserved but differently framed inputs can significantly destabilize LLM decisions. To systematically investigate this problem, we introduce Fragile, a large-scale benchmark that isolates fact-preserving semantic framing across three controlled dimensions: value-tinted narration, temporal slice, and narrative vividness. Our experiments reveal a high susceptibility of LLMs to framing, with an average decision flip rate of 28.6%. We find that simple prior prompt-level and activation-level interventions not only fail to suppress framing sensitivity but actively amplify it. We therefore propose Valign, a representation-level method that explicitly targets these framing dimensions by anchoring decisions to a stable value prior, steering hidden states toward the model's value-consistent direction, and projecting out temporal-vividness-sensitive directions from the model's hidden states. Valign consistently reduces framing-induced decision flips, demonstrating that robust mitigation requires directly targeting the internal pathways in which framing operates.

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLM在面对事实相同但措辞不同的输入时，平均决策翻转率达28.6%，并提出了一种名为Valign的表示层方法，通过锚定价值先验、引导隐藏状态、投影去除时间和生动性敏感方向，有效降低了框架效应导致的决策不一致。
AI.motivation: LLM在法律推理等高风险决策场景中日益普及，但事实等价但框架不同的输入会显著破坏LLM的决策一致性，现有简单干预方法不仅无效反而加剧问题。
AI.method: 提出Fragile基准，从价值倾向、时间切片、叙述生动性三个维度隔离事实保持的语义框架；提出Valign方法，通过锚定稳定价值先验、引导隐藏状态向价值一致方向、投影去除时间和生动性敏感方向来减少框架效应。
AI.result: LLM平均决策翻转率为28.6%，简单提示层和激活层干预会放大框架敏感性，而Valign一致性地减少了框架诱导的决策翻转。
AI.conclusion: 稳健缓解框架效应需要直接针对框架操作发生的内部表示通路进行干预，而非依赖表面提示或简单激活修改。

title: Adaptive Temporal Gating of Longitudinal Magnetic Resonance Imaging for Alzheimer's Prediction
summary: Predicting conversion from Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI) to Alzheimer's Disease (AD) is critical for early intervention. Current deep learning paradigms predominantly rely on cross-sectional structural MRI, neglecting prognostic value in patient-specific anatomical trajectories. We introduce the Temporal Adaptive Fusion Network (TAF-Net), a hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture that models paired longitudinal 3D MRI scans. Central to TAF-Net is a Temporal Fusion Module governed by an Adaptive Temporal Gate, which learns patient-specific weightings to synthesize three spatiotemporal representations: explicit structural change, region-to-region temporal cross-attention, and bilateral feature concatenation.
